mapper.select: SELECT e.*, u.nickname as userName FROM evaluation e LEFT JOIN user u ON e.user_id = u.user_id WHERE e.product_id = #{productId} AND e.eval_status = 1 ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
SELECT e.*, p.model as productName FROM evaluation e LEFT JOIN product p ON e.product_id = p.product_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.eval_status = 1 ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
